content: उपजप् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To whisper into the ears of (another), win over to oneʼs party by secretly suggesting anything in the ear; अङ्गारवर्षं राजवधायोपजप्य <ls>Dk. 104</ls>; क्षत्तारं कुरुराजस्तु शनैः कर्णमुपाजपत् <ls>Mb.</ls> .²2 (Hence) to instigate to rebellion or treachery, conspire with; उपजप्यानुपजपेत् <ls>Ms. 7. 197</ls>. .²3 To commit mischief.
